title: Kim Hye-soo keeps vigil for third day at Choi Bul-am's funeral
text:
Kim Hye-soo keeps vigil for third day at Choi Bul-am's funeral - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 2일(월) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Kim Hye-soo keeps vigil for third day at Choi Bul-am's funeral 
 입력 2026.11.01. 20:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Actor Kim Hye-soo has been keeping vigil and paying respects at the late Choi Bul-am's funeral altar for the third day.
 On the 1st, at the funeral hall of Asan Medical Center in Songpa-gu, Seoul, colleagues and juniors from the entertainment world and figures from politics and business continued to visit the deceased's altar.
 On the third day of the funeral, actors Kang Boo-ja and Lee Je-hoon paid their respects, and Yoo In-chon, the former Minister of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism who was the first to visit the altar on the first day of the funeral, also came to pay tribute.
 Among them, actor Kim Hye-soo visited the altar for three consecutive days from the first day of condolences through the 31st and today (the 1st), tending to the bereaved family and mourners. In particular, Kim Hye-soo supported the late Choi Bul-am's wife Kim Min and took attentive care of her, greeting and speaking with the mourners.
 A scene was also captured of her neatly arranging the shoes that mourners had taken off, and when senior actors Yoon Yeo-jung and Ko Doo-shim left the altar, she personally saw them off, showing a daughterlike manner.
 In fact, Choi Bul-am and his wife Kim Min are known to have maintained a parent-and-child–like relationship with Kim Hye-soo for a long time. When Kim Hye-soo was a first-year high school student in 1987, she and Kim Min played mother and daughter in the drama "Samogok". Through that, Kim Hye-soo developed a deep bond with the couple, and in 2021 she appeared on KBS "Koreans' table" 10th anniversary special and described the two as "like a mother and father," attracting attention.
 At the time, the text messages exchanged between Kim Hye-soo and Choi Bul-am became a topic of discussion online. Kim Hye-soo revealed the exchanged messages, saying, "Teacher, your texts are always poetic. I look at them again and again. They make me feel good."
 Choi Bul-am sent a message to Kim Hye-soo, who had gone abroad, saying, "I heard you went abroad and then came back and are heading to New York again. How can you travel such a long distance of twelve or thirteen hours and return? Leaving behind the cool breeze of Seoul, have a glass of wine and you must sleep! You should rest your body while erasing longing and yearning so that New York will suit you."
 He added, "Autumn is the season of longing, the season when grapes ripen. The airplane should be a season of dreams. Then go and come back. I want to hear about the dream Hye-soo had!"
 Meanwhile, Choi Bul-am debuted in 1959 in the play "Hamlet," and later appeared in dramas such as "Chief Inspector" and "Rural Diary," receiving national love.
 Choi Bul-am died at 10:30 p.m. on the 29th while receiving treatment at a hospital in Gangseo-gu, Seoul, due to deteriorating health. He was 87. The deceased's altar was set up at the funeral hall of Asan Medical Center, and the funeral procession will be held at 7:40 a.m. on the 2nd.
